title: That QR code could be a trap #shorts
description:
Scammers stick fake QR codes over real ones on parking meters and posters to steal card details. Pay through the official app or type the website yourself.

#cybersecurity #qrcode #scam #privacy #shorts
sub: It might not be the real one...

points.d: covering the real code on the meter.
a fake payment page that looks official.
they keep the details you typed in.

fix:
Pay in the official app
or type the site yourself
fix_sub: Look for stickers. Check the link first.
question: Have you ever seen a fake QR sticker? Yes or No in the comments
